clue.text: Endlessly pick the best sailors to give help to baker

indicators.note: endlessly means the phrase loses its final letter, so only its last F is dropped

parts.note: to cream off is to pick the best part of something
a tar is a sailor; the plural gives two of them
the second of the two sailors, another tar

explanation.surface: An instruction to cherry-pick the finest seamen to lend a hand to someone baking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' trims CREAM OFF to CREAM OF; 'sailors' supplies two TARs side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: This powder is a raising agent that bakers mix with bicarbonate of soda, so it is an aid in baking.

clue.text: Ordinary bits of land separated by ordinary railings, initially

parts.note: a common is a piece of open public land

indicators.note: initially tells us to take only the opening letter of each of the two words before it

parts.note: a garden is another plot of land

explanation.surface: Plain plots of ground divided from each other by plain fencing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes O and R from 'ordinary railings', and these go between the two bits of land, as 'separated by' says.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes anything plain and everyday, of the usual unremarkable kind.

clue.text: Boredom 'impends any changes would delight their hearts

indicators.note: their hearts asks for the central letter of each of the five words just before it

explanation.surface: Weariness looms, though any change would cheer people up.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letters of impends, any, changes, would and delight are E, N, N, U, I. The stray quote mark before 'impends' is a printing blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: The French loan word names a listless weariness from having nothing interesting to do.

clue.text: Clergyman assisting islander aboard

parts.note: a Minorcan is a native of the Balearic island of Minorca
aboard a ship or train is on it

explanation.surface: A priest's helper who comes from an island and is on board a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: This cathedral cleric is a junior priest who assists with services but is not a member of the chapter.

clue.text: Hot and cold days cause annoyance

parts.note: February, abbreviated Feb, is a run of cold winter days
to rile is to irritate

explanation.surface: Weather that swings between heat and chill is irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hot and cold' looks like one phrase, but 'Hot' alone is the definition, in its feverish sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Feverish is the core meaning, and a person in a fever feels hot.

clue.text: Young woman loses head and administers a beating up that's very bad

indicators.note: loses head means the first letter of the word for the young woman is dropped

parts.note: baby is slang for a young woman or girlfriend

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word for beating is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: to lam someone is to thrash them

explanation.surface: A girl decapitated and then thrashed: a dreadful tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses head' strips B from BABY to leave ABY; 'up' turns LAMS into SMAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dreadful or appallingly poor is described this way, as if bottomless in its awfulness.

clue.text: Shy way to decide

explanation.surface: A bashful approach to making up one's mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To shy is to throw or fling, and flipping a coin is a common method of settling a choice.

clue.text: Roger and I violated the Mexican border

indicators.note: violated suggests the three words are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: Two people illegally crossing from Mexico into the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: The great river forms much of the frontier between Texas and Mexico.

clue.text: Battle — one of the colours found on a tree

parts.note: Blenheim was Marlborough's victory of 1704 in Bavaria
orange is one of the colours of the rainbow

explanation.surface: A battle and a regimental colour, with something growing up in a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: this is an English apple variety, so it grows on a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: This dessert apple variety, first grown near the Blenheim estate in Oxfordshire, is fruit hanging from a tree.

clue.text: Many a bond is forged from childhood

indicators.note: is forged suggests the letters of the three words are hammered into a new shape

explanation.surface: Lifelong friendships are formed when people are young.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means throughout one's life from youth onward, as in working somewhere since boyhood.

clue.text: To lower a boat, start to leeward

parts.note: a scow is a flat-bottomed boat

indicators.note: start to means only the opening letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: Sailing instructions for letting a boat down, beginning on the sheltered side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lower' here rhymes with 'flower': to frown or look threatening.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower, pronounced like lour, is to frown sullenly, which is what this facial expression is.

clue.text: 'c provides clothing put in baskets

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as "'c provides clothing put in baskets": the opening word is garbled by OCR (perhaps a HOSIER-minus-H device), and no search finds the printed text.

clue.text: One doctor dressing a foot

indicators.note: dressing here means the doctor's letters are placed alongside the a, finishing it off

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A single medic applying a bandage to someone's foot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foot' is the poetic sense, a unit of metre, not the body part a doctor might dress.
explanation.definitionFit: In prosody this metrical unit has a short syllable followed by a long one.

clue.text: Smooth pair starting

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as "Smooth pair starting": 'Smooth' defines IRON but 'pair starting' gives no parse for the remaining letters; the clue looks cut short and no search finds the full text.

clue.text: Getting cold, sweetheart? This'll provide a coat

parts.note: icing up is getting very cold
sugar is a term of endearment like honey or sweetheart

explanation.surface: Someone checks a shivering partner and offers a coat.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'coat' is a cake's top layer, not a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: This fine powdered confection is mixed with water to cover cakes in a sweet layer.

clue.text: We are so old, swallowing tea, say, is an indignity

indicators.note: swallowing means one piece is taken inside the other

parts.note: our age is how old we are
tea sounds like the letter T

explanation.surface: Elderly people complain that being kept waiting for their tea is an insult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tea, say' is the letter T, which sounds like tea.
explanation.definitionFit: An affront or gross insult arousing anger is this.

clue.text: Moulded polythene used in communications

indicators.note: moulded suggests the plastic is reshaped, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Shaped plastic employed in making phone equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the technology of transmitting speech over distance by wire or radio.

clue.text: Permit silence to be broken

indicators.note: to be broken suggests the word silence is smashed and its letters reassembled

explanation.surface: Permission is granted for someone to break the quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To authorise or allow formally is the verb sense, the US spelling of licence.

clue.text: Head of Government owns tree

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of the following word

parts.note: to own in the sense of admit or concede is to allow

explanation.surface: The leader of the government is the owner of a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tree' is an old word for the gibbet; 'owns' means admits.
explanation.definitionFit: Tree is an archaic or literary word for the gibbet, the frame used for hanging.

clue.text: Soldiers upset English girl and Italian woman

indicators.note: in a down entry upset means turning the soldiers' letters upside down, reading them backwards

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
Nora is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Troops distress a young Englishwoman and a woman from Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Italian title for a married lady, equivalent to Mrs or madam.

clue.text: Ray and Susan receiving note before noon

indicators.note: receiving means one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: Sue is short for Susan
NB, nota bene, is a note
a.m. means before noon

explanation.surface: Two people called Ray and Susan get a message in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like a man's name beside Susan; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaft of sunlight is a ray.

clue.text: Interrupting a mouthful jester finally put on fool's cap.

indicators.note: put on, in a down entry, places the first part above the second
interrupting means one letter breaks into the middle of the other word

parts.note: a sup is a small mouthful of drink

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the word before it

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: The jester, interrupting a mouthful, finally dons a fool's cap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fool's cap' looks like a jester's hat, but 'cap' alone is the definition, meaning outdo.
explanation.definitionFit: To cap something is to outdo or top it, as when capping a story.

clue.text: Plant cultivated in part of Sussex

explanation.surface: A crop grown in a corner of southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Oilseed rape is a yellow-flowered crop grown widely; Sussex was historically divided into six administrative districts called rapes.

clue.text: Gelatinous substance obtained from a fish

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Jelly made from fish, like isinglass.
explanation.walkthrough: The real substance comes from seaweed, not fish, which is what makes the surface plausible but misleading.
explanation.definitionFit: This jelly-like material extracted from seaweed is used as a culture medium and thickener.

clue.text: Deity in South America, the god of war

parts.note: Tyr is the Norse god of war

explanation.surface: A war god worshipped somewhere in South America.
explanation.walkthrough: The Norse war god TYR is less familiar than Mars or Ares.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this woodland creature, half man and half goat, is a minor god.

clue.text: All show disapproval-it comes to the 'surface

parts.note: to tut is to click the tongue in disapproval

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming to the surface means rising, so it is read upwards

explanation.surface: Everyone voices disapproval when it surfaces.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray quote mark before 'surface' is a printing blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: In music this Italian term directs all the performers to play together.

clue.text: In the party roll, his initial is L

indicators.note: in signals that the answer is found within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: On the party list his first letter is given as L.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his initial is L' refers to the L-plate a learner driver displays.
explanation.definitionFit: A novice or beginner, like a learner driver who displays an L plate.

clue.text: Decoration turns city black

indicators.note: turns means the honour's letters are reversed

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour
NY is New York

explanation.surface: An honour makes a city go dark.
explanation.definitionFit: The dense dark wood gives its name to a deep black colour.

clue.text: Sounded inside out, an ape

indicators.note: inside means the first word is put within the next

parts.note: taken as written
sounded, as a bell did, is rang

explanation.surface: A noise rings out, and an ape appears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside out' reads as one phrase, but 'inside' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: This red-haired great ape lives in the forests of Borneo and Sumatra.

clue.text: In. trouble, so many receive invaluable help

indicators.note: in trouble suggests the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: When people are in difficulties, many get assistance.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray full stop after 'In' is a printing blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means loyal, valuable service, like that of a faithful retainer.
